name: Max & Mia — Nursery Rhyme Pipeline v5

parameters.jsCode:
// Lyrics-Template Generator — original lyrics, kein Copyright-Problem!
const theme = $input.first().json.theme;
const suno_api_key = $input.first().json.suno_api_key;

const templates = {
  'Baa Baa Black Sheep': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(gentle glockenspiel melody)

[Verse 1]
Woolly sheep woolly sheep have you got some fleece?
Oh yes indeed give my shearing a piece!
One bag for teacher one bag for friend
And one for the children playing round the bend!

[Chorus]
Fluffy sheep fluffy sheep soft as a cloud!
Fluffy sheep fluffy sheep singing out loud!

[Verse 2]
Woolly sheep woolly sheep dancing in the sun
Your fluffy white coat makes the children run!
Spin the wool spin the wool round and around
The softest sweetest music in the town!

[Chorus]
Fluffy sheep fluffy sheep soft as a cloud!
Fluffy sheep fluffy sheep singing out loud!

[Outro]
(gentle glockenspiel fade)`,
    style: "children's nursery rhyme, glockenspiel lead melody, xylophone, bouncy 3/4 waltz, toy piano, recorder flute, upbeat cheerful, 85 BPM"
  },

  'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(twinkling glockenspiel intro)

[Verse 1]
Shimmer shimmer little light
Sparkle sparkling through the night!
Way up high above the trees
Glowing gentle in the breeze!

[Chorus]
Shimmer shimmer little light
How you twinkle shining bright!

[Verse 2]
When the golden sun goes down
And the moon wears its nightgown
There you are the first to glow
Putting on your starlight show!

[Chorus]
Shimmer shimmer little light
How you twinkle shining bright!

[Bridge]
Starlight starlight in the sky
Winking as the clouds float by
Till the morning paints the dawn
You will shine all night till gone!

[Outro]
(dreamy music box fade)`,
    style: "children's lullaby nursery rhyme, glockenspiel, music box, xylophone, dreamy waltz, soft toy piano, gentle and calm, 75 BPM"
  },

  'Hickory Dickory Dock': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(tick tock clock rhythm)

[Verse 1]
Tickety tockety on the clock
A tiny mouse came as a shock!
The bell rang once — ding!
The mouse did spring!
Tickety tockety tick tock!

[Chorus]
Tick tock tickety dock!
Tick tock tickety dock!

[Verse 2]
Tickety tockety on the clock
The mouse came back around the block!
The bell rang twice — ding ding!
Down the mouse did swing!
Tickety tockety tick tock!

[Chorus]
Tick tock tickety dock!
Tick tock tickety dock!

[Verse 3]
Tickety tockety on the clock
The mouse now dances round the dock!
The bell rings three — ding ding ding!
Everybody sing!
Tickety tockety tick tock!

[Outro]
(clock chime fades away)`,
    style: "children's nursery rhyme, bouncy staccato glockenspiel, playful xylophone, ticking percussion, upbeat fun, 95 BPM"
  },

  'Jack and Jill': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(bouncy hill-climbing melody)

[Verse 1]
Max and Mia climb the hill
Fetch a bucket at the well!
Max trips over tumbles down
Mia follows with a frown!

[Chorus]
Up the hill up the hill!
Max and Mia go!
Up the hill up the hill!
With the bucket so!

[Verse 2]
Max got up and ran back home
No more on that hill to roam!
Mia laughed and skipped along
Singing her own happy song!

[Chorus]
Up the hill up the hill!
Max and Mia go!
Up the hill up the hill!
With the bucket so!

[Outro]
(happy bouncy ending)`,
    style: "children's nursery rhyme, cheerful glockenspiel, bouncy folk rhythm, xylophone, accordion, upbeat playful, 90 BPM"
  },

  'Mary Had a Little Lamb': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(gentle flute and glockenspiel)

[Verse 1]
Mia has a fluffy lamb
White as morning snow!
Everywhere that Mia goes
The little lamb must go!

[Chorus]
Little lamb little lamb
Folowing Mia all day!
Little lamb little lamb
Always wants to play!

[Verse 2]
Followed her to school one day
Made the children cheer!
Max and Mia and the lamb
All laughed year to year!

[Chorus]
Little lamb little lamb
Following Mia all day!
Little lamb little lamb
Always wants to play!

[Outro]
(sweet gentle fade)`,
    style: "children's nursery rhyme, gentle glockenspiel, flute melody, soft xylophone, warm and tender, 80 BPM"
  },

  'Ring Around the Rosie': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(spinning circular melody)

[Verse 1]
Circle circle round we go
Holding hands and spinning so!
Petals flowers in our pockets
Spinning round like little rockets!

[Chorus]
Spin around spin around!
Everybody down!
Spin around spin around!
Best game in the town!

[Verse 2]
Max and Mia laugh and spin
Round and round with giant grins!
Flowers petals fill the air
Singing dancing everywhere!

[Chorus]
Spin around spin around!
Everybody down!
Spin around spin around!
Best game in the town!

[Outro]
(dizzy happy laughter ending)`,
    style: "children's nursery rhyme, circular spinning waltz, glockenspiel, xylophone, playful and dizzy fun, 88 BPM"
  },

  'Little Miss Muffet': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(tiptoeing sneaky melody)

[Verse 1]
Little Mia sitting down
Eating pudding in the town!
Along crept a hairy spider
Sitting right down beside her!

[Chorus]
Oh no oh no!
A spider came to say hello!
Oh no oh no!
She jumped up and away did go!

[Verse 2]
Little Mia came back soon
Spider gone by afternoon!
She ate her yummy pudding then
And smiled her biggest smile again!

[Chorus]
Hooray hooray!
No spider ruined her day!
Hooray hooray!
She laughed and sang and played!

[Outro]
(happy resolution ending)`,
    style: "children's nursery rhyme, sneaky playful glockenspiel, xylophone, pizzicato rhythm, spooky fun then happy, 85 BPM"
  },

  'Humpty Dumpty': {
    lyrics: `[Intro]
(proud majestic fanfare)

[Verse 1]
Roundly Rumply on the wall
Roundly Rumply had a fall!
All the horses all the men
Couldn't fix poor Round again!

[Chorus]
Roundy Roundy on the wall!
Roundy Roundy had a fall!
All the helpers all the friends
Couldn't make him whole again!

[Verse 2]
Roundly Rumply was so proud
Balancing and laughing loud!
Danced a step too near the edge
Tumbled off the mossy ledge!

[Chorus]
Roundy Roundy on the wall!
Roundy Roundy had a fall!

[Outro]
(sad but hopeful ending)`,
    style: "children's nursery rhyme waltz 3/4, bouncy folk swing, glockenspiel melody, xylophone, recorder flute, toy piano, upbeat 90 BPM"
  }
};

const key = Object.keys(templates).find(k =>
  k.toLowerCase() === theme.toLowerCase()
) || 'Baa Baa Black Sheep';

const template = templates[key];

return [{ json: {
  lyrics: template.lyrics,
  style: template.style,
  theme: key,
  suno_api_key: suno_api_key
} }];

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "prompt": {{ JSON.stringify($json.lyrics) }},
  "style": {{ JSON.stringify($json.style) }},
  "title": {{ JSON.stringify($json.theme + ' - Max und Mia World') }},
  "customMode": true,
  "instrumental": false,
  "model": "V3_5",
  "callBackUrl": "https://webhook.site/maxmia-placeholder",
  "negativeTags": "heavy metal, rock, electric guitar, drums, dark, sad"
}
